title: coryphopteris engleriana
intro: Coryphopteris engleriana, commonly known as the East African fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including treating fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Coryphopteris engleriana include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of this plant may also help to protect against oxidative stress and inflammation, making it a potential source of natural therapeutics.
